learning_outcomes.text: Students who have successfully completed this module will have fundamental knowledge of the function and application of sensor technology components and systems.
Students will have practical experience in the selection, characterization, and application of sensor technology components and systems.

Students are able to interpret characteristics and measurement data of systems and develop concepts for sensor technology systems. Students learn to contribute to increased energy efficiency with intelligent sensor technology: careful selection of sensors leads to more sustainable solutions.

Practical experiences with sensor technology are based on the use of technologies in different teaching forms with a high degree of independence, whereby the insights are transferred to case studies, experimental work in the lab, and a project work.
They are able to design and implement sensor technology system solutions with broad technical interdisciplinarity.
Students can discuss the results in the course with each other.
They are able to systematically plan, carry out an experimental work and a project independently in a small team, present it to a larger group of students, and address critical questions.

syllabus_topics: Application areas of different measurement principles
assessment_rules: The graded examination performance consists of either a written project report (10-20 pages) or an oral examination. The ungraded examination performance is an experimental work, comprising approximately 5 experiments of 90 minutes each. The type of examination (project report or oral exam) is chosen by the examiner.
